title: Analytics
description: The data warehouse (README, Analytics): the ETL's runs and freshness, each source's history, and ClickHouse itself. Needs the analytics profile.

panels.title: Last extract per source
panels.description: The latest scheduled extract of each source: failed if any of its views failed (after the task's retries), its duration, the rows it loaded and when it ended.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, if(countIf(state = 'failed') > 0, 'failed', 'success') AS state, max(finished) AS ended, dateDiff('millisecond', min(started), max(finished)) / 1000 AS duration_seconds, sum(rows) AS rows FROM (SELECT source, target, argMax(state, finished_at) AS state, min(started_at) AS started, max(finished_at) AS finished, argMax(rows, finished_at) AS rows FROM meta.runs WHERE kind = 'extract' AND (source, run_id) IN (SELECT source, argMax(run_id, finished_at) FROM meta.runs WHERE kind = 'extract' GROUP BY source) GROUP BY source, target) GROUP BY source ORDER BY source

panels.title: Freshness per source
panels.description: Now minus the newest change loaded from the source (the highest watermark of its views). Red past 15 minutes: the extracts run every 5, so the source has not been read for at least two cycles, or nothing in it has changed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, dateDiff('second', max(watermark), now64(3)) AS freshness_seconds FROM meta.watermarks FINAL GROUP BY source ORDER BY source

panels.title: Extract duration per source
panels.description: Each scheduled extract run of a source, from its first view's start to its last view's end.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(finished_at) AS time, source, dateDiff('millisecond', min(started_at), max(finished_at)) / 1000 AS duration_seconds FROM meta.runs WHERE kind = 'extract' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY source, run_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rows loaded per run
panels.description: Rows each extract run loaded into staging, per source, including the rows the 5-minute overlap reads again.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(finished_at) AS time, source, sum(rows) AS rows FROM meta.runs WHERE kind = 'extract' AND state = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY source, run_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: XP granted per day by source
panels.description: XP granted per day from battles and raids. XP whose grant was revoked (its battle's settlement was compensated) is its own series, not counted in the others.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, sumIf(amount, source = 'BATTLE' AND revoked_at IS NULL) AS battle, sumIf(amount, source = 'RAID' AND revoked_at IS NULL) AS raid, sumIf(amount, revoked_at IS NOT NULL) AS revoked FROM dw.fact_xp FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Transfers per day
panels.description: Ownership transfers per day (a battle's winner takes the loser's primary), and those later reverted because the battle was voided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(transferred_at) AS time, countIf(reverted_at IS NULL) AS kept, countIf(reverted_at IS NOT NULL) AS reverted FROM dw.fact_transfer FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(transferred_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tamagotchis per level band
panels.description: How many Tamagotchis are at each level band now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(level < 5, '1-4', level < 10, '5-9', level < 20, '10-19', level < 50, '20-49', '50+') AS band, count() AS tamagotchis FROM dw.dim_tamagotchi FINAL GROUP BY band ORDER BY min(level)

panels.title: Tamagotchis per combat type
panels.description: How many Tamagotchis there are of each combat type.

targets.rawSql: SELECT combat_type, count() AS tamagotchis FROM dw.dim_tamagotchi FINAL GROUP BY combat_type ORDER BY combat_type

panels.title: Battles per day and win rate by combat type
panels.description: Counts battle creation. Win rate is the share of combatant appearances on the winning side for each combat type, for completed and forfeited battles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, count() AS battles
FROM dw.fact_battle FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(b.settled_at) AS time, t.combat_type,
       avg(toUInt8(p.user_id = b.winner_user_id)) AS win_rate
FROM (
    SELECT battle_id, winner_user_id, settled_at
    FROM dw.fact_battle FINAL
    WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FORFEITED') AND $__timeFilter(settled_at)
) AS b
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT battle_id, user_id, tamagotchi_id FROM dw.fact_battle_combatant FINAL
) AS p ON p.battle_id = b.battle_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT tamagotchi_id, combat_type FROM dw.dim_tamagotchi FINAL
) AS t ON t.tamagotchi_id = p.tamagotchi_id
GROUP BY time, t.combat_type ORDER BY time, t.combat_type

panels.title: Completed and voided settlements and duration
panels.description: Counts callback outcomes and measures elapsed time from combat end to settlement. Historical rows without both timestamps are excluded from percentiles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(settled_at) AS time, status, count() AS settlements
FROM dw.fact_battle FINAL
WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'VOIDED') AND $__timeFilter(settled_at)
GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time, status

SELECT toStartOfDay(settled_at) AS time,
       quantile(0.50)(settlement_duration_ms) AS p50_ms,
       quantile(0.95)(settlement_duration_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM dw.fact_battle FINAL
WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FORFEITED', 'VOIDED') AND $__timeFilter(settled_at)
  AND settlement_duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Coins in and out by reason and package
panels.description: Incoming and outgoing coins are shown as positive magnitudes, with a separate series for each reason and package. Global currency has no package.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time,
       concat(reason, ' / ', coalesce(toString(package_id), 'GLOBAL')) AS series,
       sumIf(amount, amount > 0) AS coins_in,
       -sumIf(amount, amount < 0) AS coins_out
FROM dw.fact_ledger FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Active players per day
panels.description: Counts each user once per UTC day if they took part in a battle created that day or had a ledger entry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, uniqExact(user_id) AS active_players
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time,
           arrayJoin([challenger_user_id, opponent_user_id]) AS user_id
    FROM dw.fact_battle FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, user_id
    FROM dw.fact_ledger FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Members per guild over time
panels.description: Daily closing membership by guild in UTC, including members who joined before the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH toDate($__fromTime) AS first_day
SELECT
    greatest(toDateTime(calendar.date, 'UTC'), $__fromTime) AS time,
    concat(guilds.name, ' (', toString(guilds.guild_id), ')') AS guild,
    sum(deltas.change) OVER (
        PARTITION BY guilds.guild_id ORDER BY calendar.date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS members
FROM (SELECT date FROM dw.dim_date FINAL
      WHERE date BETWEEN first_day AND toDate($__toTime)) AS calendar
CROSS JOIN (SELECT guild_id, name, created_at, deleted_at FROM dw.dim_guild FINAL) AS guilds
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT guild_id, greatest(toDate(occurred_at), first_day) AS day, sum(delta) AS change
    FROM (
        SELECT guild_id, joined_at AS occurred_at, toInt64(1) AS delta
        FROM dw.fact_membership FINAL WHERE joined_at <= $__toTime
        UNION ALL
        SELECT guild_id, assumeNotNull(left_at) AS occurred_at, toInt64(-1) AS delta
        FROM dw.fact_membership FINAL WHERE left_at <= $__toTime
    )
    GROUP BY guild_id, day
) AS deltas ON deltas.guild_id = guilds.guild_id AND deltas.day = calendar.date
WHERE calendar.date >= greatest(first_day, toDate(guilds.created_at))
  AND (guilds.deleted_at IS NULL OR calendar.date <= toDate(guilds.deleted_at))
ORDER BY time, guild

panels.title: Joins and leaves per day
panels.description: Membership starts and ends inside the selected range, grouped by UTC day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT greatest(toDateTime(day, 'UTC'), $__fromTime) AS time,
       countIf(joined) AS joins, countIf(NOT joined) AS leaves
FROM (
    SELECT toDate(joined_at) AS day, true AS joined
    FROM dw.fact_membership FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(joined_at)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT toDate(assumeNotNull(left_at)) AS day, false AS joined
    FROM dw.fact_membership FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(left_at)
)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Users per package
panels.description: Distinct registered users per package, including packages without users.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.name AS package, p.version, p.package_id, ifNull(u.users, 0) AS users
FROM (SELECT package_id, name, version FROM dw.dim_package FINAL) AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT package_id, uniqExact(user_id) AS users
    FROM dw.fact_user_package FINAL
    GROUP BY package_id
) AS u ON p.package_id = u.package_id
ORDER BY users DESC, package, version, package_id

panels.title: Guilds per required package
panels.description: Current, non-deleted guilds grouped by the package they require, including packages without guilds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.name AS package, p.version, p.package_id, ifNull(g.guilds, 0) AS guilds
FROM (SELECT package_id, name, version FROM dw.dim_package FINAL) AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT assumeNotNull(required_package_id) AS package_id, count() AS guilds
    FROM dw.dim_guild FINAL
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND required_package_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY package_id
) AS g ON p.package_id = g.package_id
ORDER BY guilds DESC, package, version, package_id

panels.title: Packages by status
panels.description: Packages counted by their latest lifecycle status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status, count() AS packages
FROM dw.dim_package FINAL
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status

panels.title: Raids per day by status
panels.description: Raids by the day they started, stacked by status: ACTIVE, COMPLETED, FAILED.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(starts_at) AS time, countIf(status = 'ACTIVE') AS active, countIf(status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed, countIf(status = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM dw.fact_raid FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Raid success rate per guild
panels.description: COMPLETED raids over finished (COMPLETED or FAILED) raids, per guild id, for raids started in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(guild_id) AS guild, countIf(status = 'COMPLETED') / count() AS success_rate FROM dw.fact_raid FINAL WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND $__timeFilter(starts_at) GROUP BY guild_id ORDER BY success_rate DESC

panels.title: Raid duration p50 / p95
panels.description: finished_at - starts_at of the finished raids, by the day they started.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(starts_at) AS time, quantile(0.5)(duration_seconds) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(duration_seconds) AS p95 FROM dw.fact_raid FINAL WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(starts_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Damage per participant
panels.description: Distribution of the damage each participant dealt in a raid, for participations that joined in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT damage_dealt FROM dw.fact_raid_participation FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(joined_at)

panels.title: Participants per raid
panels.description: How many raids had each number of participants, for raids started in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(participant_count) AS participants, count() AS raids FROM dw.fact_raid FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) GROUP BY participant_count ORDER BY participant_count

panels.title: ClickHouse uptime
panels.description: How long the warehouse has been up. No data: ClickHouse is not running (start the stack with the analytics profile).

targets.rawSql: SELECT uptime() AS uptime

panels.title: Rows and bytes per table
panels.description: Every staging and warehouse table: rows and compressed bytes on disk, from the active parts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS table, sum(rows) AS rows, sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database IN ('staging', 'dw') GROUP BY database, table ORDER BY database, table

panels.title: Queries per minute
panels.description: Queries the warehouse finished per minute (the ETL's loads and transforms, and these dashboards), and those that failed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, countIf(type = 'QueryFinish') AS finished, countIf(type IN ('ExceptionBeforeStart', 'ExceptionWhileProcessing')) AS failed FROM system.query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
